title: NavTTT: Adaptive Parametric Memory via Hierarchical Test-Time Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) demands that agents accumulate and reason over streaming visual observations throughout long navigation episodes. Existing approaches struggle to maintain long-term history, constrained by the finite context capacity of transformer architectures. To solve the problem, fast-weight test-time training (TTT) provides a mechanism for encoding streaming observations into an evolving parameter state. However, existing TTT does not distinguish informative observations from repetitive visual content, allowing redundant tokens to interfere with the retention of information needed for subsequent decisions. We propose Navigation-Conditioned Test-Time Training (NavTTT), which introduces adaptive memory formation and hierarchical memory integration for vision-and-language navigation. translated_title: NavTTT：基于分层测试时训练的视觉-语言导航自适应参数记忆
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在长导航过程中对持续的流式视觉观测进行积累与推理。现有方法受限于Transformer架构有限的上下文容量，难以维持长期历史信息。为解决该问题，快速权重的测试时训练（TTT）提供了一种将流式观测编码为不断演化的参数状态的机制。然而，现有的TTT无法区分信息性观测与重复性视觉内容，使得冗余token会干扰对后续决策所需信息的保留。我们提出导航条件化测试时训练（NavTTT），为视觉-语言导航引入自适应记忆形成与分层记忆整合。NavTTT利用全局导航上下文来优先处理具有信息量的视觉证据，并将语言指令与空间信息相结合。
tldr: 提出NavTTT，一种导航条件化的分层测试时训练方法，通过自适应记忆形成与分层记忆整合，利用全局导航上下文优先保留信息性视觉证据，解决长导航过程中冗余观测干扰长期记忆保留的问题。
en_tdlr: NavTTT introduces a navigation-conditioned hierarchical test-time training framework with adaptive memory formation and hierarchical memory integration, leveraging global navigation context to prioritize informative visual evidence and prevent redundant observations from degrading long-term memory in vision-and-language navigation.
